text:
A extraña ha venido

to compartir my cuarto in esta casa that anda mal of the head,

a muchacha loca as the pájaros,


traba the door of the night with his brazos, his plumas.

Ceñida in the cama revuelta

alucina with nubes in esta casa to prueba of cielos,


until alucina with his pasos este cuarto of pesadilla.

free as the muertos

or cabalga the mares imaginarios of the pabellón of hombres.


Ha llegado posesa

the that admite the alucinante light to través of the muro saltarín,

posesa for the cielos


ella duerme in the canal estrecho, until camina the polvo,

until desvaría to gusto

over the mesas of the manicomio adelgazadas for my lágrimas.


And tomado for the light of his brazos, to the fin, my Dios, to the fin

puedo I of verdad

soportar the primera visión that incendia the estrellas.

translation.title: Love in the manicomio
